newsitem.title: USA: San Antonio feeder cattle steady-off $4 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: San Antonio feeder cattle steady-off $4 - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers steady to firm, except steers under 400 lbs $3.00-$4.00 per cwt lower and heifers under 500 lbs steady to mostly $3.00 lower, compared to Monday, USDA said.

Bulk of supply Medium and Large 1-2 300-600 lb feeder steers and heifers. Supply included around 8 percent slaughter cows and bulls; 15 percent feeder cattle over 600 lbs with balance mostly feeder cattle under 600 lbs.
Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 - 600-700 lbs 67.50-76.50, pkg 80.00; 700-775 lbs 65.25-69.00; pkg 872 lbs 65.25. Medium and Large 1-2 - 600-800 lbs 63.00-65.25.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 - 600-650 lbs 66.25-73.25; pkg 705 lbs 65.25. Medium and Large 1-2 - 500-800 lbs 56.50-66.50.
